label: Late-episode D1 after an a1 -> S2 (rare) rewarded trial
explanation: Fires only at D1 steps where the reward input is 1, and only in the last ~10 trials of the episode (ep_trial >= 90; nothing before trial 80; the model value is in its lowest bin there). Strong activations (~0.75 of mass, precision 0.88) come when the previously rewarded trial was a1 with a rare transition to S2, i.e. a rare-rewarded trial that should make a model-based agent switch to a2. The policy logit is near 0 at these steps. A weak tail (about 25% of mass, many steps at <0.2 of max) fires on other rewarded late-episode D1 steps, mostly after a1/S1 runs. It never fires at GO or D2, after unrewarded trials, or before trial ~80. All predicate variables are observed, so no future variables are used. Looser predicate D1 & prev_reward==1 & ep_trial>=90 gets mass recall 0.98 but precision 0.10.
